 Judgment

The appellant has filed this appeal seeking apportionment of the compensation awarded by the Senior Civil Judge and NC: 2023:KHC-K:5556 Additional MACT, Shorapur, sitting at Shahapur (henceforth referred to as 'Tribunal') in MVC No.118/2014 vide its judgment and award dated 29.10.2015.

Smt Hussainbee W/O Late Maheboobsab vs Jairabi W/O Mahaboob Sab And Ors on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54315087/
2 2.

A claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 filed by the respondent Nos.1 to 5 herein was entertained by the Tribunal and compensation of Rs.10,84,000/- was awarded to compensate the death of Mahaboob Sab in a road traffic accident on 30.12.2013 when the Moped ridden by the deceased - Mahaboob Sab was dashed against by a bus belonging to the Road Transport Corporation (henceforth referred to as 'Corporation') bearing registration No.KA-36-F-1088.
The Tribunal directed the Corporation to pay the compensation awarded along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of the claim petition till the date of realization.
3. The appellant herein has challenged the said award contending that she was the second wife of the deceased - Mahaboob Sab and therefore, she was entitled for apportionment of the compensation.
She also contended that she had filed a claim petition in MVC No.285/2015 which was NC: 2023:KHC-K:5556 pending consideration before the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi.

entities.text: III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The appellant therefore, prayed that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal in MVC No.118/2014 be apportioned between the appellant and respondent Nos.1 to 5.
4.

Per contra, learned counsel for the Corporation submitted that the Corporation has deposited the amount awarded by the Tribunal in MVC No.118/2014 and therefore, the amount deposited by it in MVC No.118/2014 may be re- deposited in MVC No.285/2015.

5. It is stated by the learned counsel for the appellant that the respondent Nos.1 and 5 have now expired and respondent Nos.2, 3 and 4 are in the care and custody of the appellant herein.
6.
If the appellant is claiming to be the second wife of the deceased - Mahaboob Sab, she has to prove the same before the Court in accordance with law.

Now that the appellant has filed a claim petition in MVC No.285/2015, the only remedy that could be granted to the appellant is to transfer MVC No.285/2015 presently pending before the III Additional Senior NC: 2023:KHC-K:5556 Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi to the Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Shorapur, sitting at Shahapur.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The amount deposited by the Corporation in MVC No.118/2014 shall be kept in deposit in MVC No.285/2015 which is now transferred from the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi to the Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Shorapur, sitting at Shahapur.

entities.label: COURT

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Shorapur, sitting at Shahapur is directed to deposit the amount in an interest earning fixed deposit in any nationalized bank for a period of three years or until the disposal of the claim petition whichever is later.
This appeal stands disposed off accordingly.
In view of disposal of the appeal, I.A.No.1/2016 does not survive for consideration and the same stands disposed off.
Office is directed to return the documents produced by the appellant along with I.A.No.1/2016.
